securite.description: Configure application security settings to protect data and access

authentification.description: Manage session duration and login policies

session_duration.label: Session Duration
session_duration.hint: Time after which the user must log in again

max_login_attempts.label: Maximum Login Attempts
max_login_attempts.hint: Number of failures allowed before account lockout

lockout_duration.label: Lockout Duration
lockout_duration.hint: Time the account is locked after failures

require_2fa.label: Require 2FA Authentication
require_2fa.hint: Require a verification code in addition to password

motsDePasse.description: Define password complexity and validity requirements

password_history_count.label: Password History
password_history_count.hint: Number of old passwords retained (0 = disabled)

avancee.description: Additional security settings to enhance protection

require_email_verification.label: Require Email Verification
require_email_verification.hint: Users must verify their email before logging in

allow_self_registration.label: Allow Self-Registration
allow_self_registration.hint: Allow users to create their own account

inactivity_timeout.label: Inactivity Timeout
inactivity_timeout.hint: Automatic logout after this period of inactivity (minutes)

ip_whitelist.label: IP Whitelist
ip_whitelist.hint: Allowed IP addresses (comma-separated, empty = all allowed)

log_sensitive_actions.label: Log Sensitive Actions
log_sensitive_actions.hint: Record all sensitive actions in the audit trail

protection.description: Protection against attacks and security monitoring

rate_limiting.label: Rate Limiting
rate_limiting.hint: Control the number of requests per minute

security_email_alerts.label: Security Email Alerts
security_email_alerts.hint: Send alerts for critical security events

suspicious_activity_notifications.label: Suspicious Activity Notifications
suspicious_activity_notifications.hint: Notify users of suspicious activity on their account

actions.description: Immediate actions to enhance application security

deconnecterSessions.description: Force logout of all currently logged in users
deconnecterSessions.confirmation: Are you sure you want to disconnect all users? This action is irreversible.
deconnecterSessions.succes: All sessions have been invalidated successfully

resetEchecs.description: Reset all failed login attempt counters to zero
resetEchecs.confirmation: Are you sure you want to reset all failure counters?

forcePasswordReset.description: Require all users to change their password on next login
forcePasswordReset.confirmation: Are you sure you want to force password change for all users? This action is irreversible.
forcePasswordReset.succes: Password change has been forced for all users
